Privacy & booking.

When you make a booking, we ask for your name, email address and phone number to arrange your visit. Appointment details and payment status are kept with your booking.

A $5 deposit is requested when online payments are active. Card details are handled by the payment provider, not stored on this website. An appointment is confirmed only after the booking system confirms the deposit.

Marketing updates are optional. The marketing checkbox starts unchecked. Booking consent and marketing consent are separate choices.

Booking times use Arizona time (America/Phoenix). If you need to change your appointment or have a question about your deposit, contact the selected shop.

Google Maps embeds and external social links use their providers’ privacy settings. Google review counts shown on this site are a snapshot, not a live feed.

For a booking or privacy question, call University at (480) 559-4539, Apache at (602) 860-5995, or Scottsdale at (602) 785-1988.
